name: The Shops at Santa Anita
description: Westfield Santa Anita is a premier shopping destination in the San Gabriel Valley featuring an extensive selection of retail, dining, and entertainment options. Located in the heart of Arcadia, this upscale mall offers a sophisticated shopping experience with both popular brands and upscale retailers in a modern, enclosed setting.
demographics: Santa Anita Mall serves an affluent and diverse trade area in the San Gabriel Valley, attracting primarily upper-middle to high-income Asian-American families and professionals aged 30-55. The shopping center's primary market includes residents from Arcadia, San Marino, and neighboring communities known for excellent schools and high household incomes exceeding $100,000. Visitors typically seek quality brands and dining experiences, with strong preferences for both American retailers and Asian-influenced dining and shopping options that reflect the area's demographic composition.
